answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. Admission is quota-limited: at most 150 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. The raven index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 464 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
